method: Every H504 10x episode and 20 seeded 5x episodes were screened automatically (adjusted vs raw path ratio, corporate actions with factors in anchor..peak, single-day adjusted moves beyond the daily price limit, ambiguous-factor and raw-close flags). Screen-flagged episodes and the largest adjusted/raw ratio gap were read by hand against raw closes, volume, listing date and the generation's corporate actions. Unflagged episodes were not read by hand.

decisions.note: +11.2% on 2011-11-29 is the fourth session after the first quote (2011-11-23); new listings trade without a daily price limit for their first five sessions. Raw and adjusted moves are equal; no action factor involved.
+18.5% on 2016-11-16 is the fourth session after the first quote (2016-11-11), inside the no-limit first five sessions. Raw and adjusted moves are equal.
2025-12-22 is the ex-right date (factor 0.984): raw close +9.87% against the previous close is +11.66% against the ex-right reference price, which is what the adjusted series shows.
+14.2% on 2024-09-03 is the second session after the first quote (2024-09-02), inside the no-limit first five sessions.

Largest adjusted/raw ratio gap (10.65x adjusted vs 4.56x raw). The 2013-08-13 EX_RIGHT factor 0.443 matches the raw close falling from 110.0 to 52.1 on that date (+7% over the ex-right reference 48.7), so the adjustment is consistent with the raw prices.
